Updated 23rd July 2026 06:53:51 AM

## Supplier Actions

Expand allCollapse all

### Overview

This article should be used to locate invoice status; where an invoice has been previously submitted but payment has not yet been received.

### Actions [...] You are also able to search for your invoice by entering the invoice number into the invoice search box.
3. Once you have located the invoice you are querying, select the invoice number to view additional information about the approval or scheduled payment status. If your invoice is on hold this may require you to complete further action. Please refer to the ‘Coupa Invoice Statuses’ guide, found here, to check this. [...] ### Actions

1. Login to Coupa Supplier Portal and select Invoices from the toolbar across the top.
2. Ensure the John Lewis Partnership customer profile is showing for the specific supplier account you are querying. On this page a full list of invoices will show that have been successfully submitted to John Lewis.
